_comment: EXAMPLE web-app feed registry. Copy to $MINERU_HOME/config/feeds.json (or point MINERU_FEEDS_FILE at it) and edit. This file REPLACES the bundled default list (app/feeds.default.json), so keep the generic feeds you want and add your own. Fields: id (stable, used in URLs and the seen ledger), dirs (brief directories relative to MINERU_HOME, each under briefs_*, reports, creations, inbox or outbox; anything else fails app startup), display_name, emoji, accent (a tokens.css accent name: sunrise, slate, gold, violet, ink, amber, teal, rose, muted), group (sidebar section, first-seen order; default 'Feeds'). Sidebar order = file order. The 'pet' and 'model_watch' entries show how to add feeds for jobs of your own; pair each with a launchd-jobs.json entry so Pulse tracks the job.
